title: mcp: the record resource answers a code-less sandboxed hook abort with the wrapper naming the hook, where GET /data answers 400 HOOK_ABORTED with the sentence
body:
domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5p3T5YWhLjurajudnQ

Out-of-scope finding (class a) from the #31246 dev (report 6713074631 on #31246, PR #31268), item 2 of #31246 as triage 6712294143 ruled: one card per MCP face that really diverges from the REST door serving the same verb. Filed by `domain:server#6`. ⛔ Not a claim. Measured by the dev on `main` with PR #31245 merged.

Reader: the seat that owns `packages/mcp`.

Suggested-grade: p2 (the #31218 code-less half, on the one face #31218 did not cover; an agent sees an internal hook name).

**Observed:** `resources/read objectstack://objects/OBJ/records/ID` whose reader throws a code-less sandboxed hook abort (`SandboxError`, `innerMessage` set) answers `{ error: "hook 'demo_guard' threw: Error: Not enough leave" }`; `GET /api/v1/data/OBJ/ID` (`mapDataError`) answers `400 HOOK_ABORTED 'Not enough leave'`. A bare `Error` answers `{ error: 'socket hang up' }` vs `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`; `SQLITE_BUSY` answers driver text with `code: SQLITE_BUSY` vs `500 DATABASE_ERROR 'Internal data error'`.

**Expected:** the record resource's catch (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`, `bridgeResources`) answers a code-less throw the way the six record data tools do since #31218 (the `mapDataError` read), never a copy. Pins per case above, red first.

Dedupe words: mcp record resource HOOK_ABORTED, bridgeResources code-less, resource mapDataError.
